key_insight: Introduce probabilistic feature imputation plus uncertainty-aware aggregation so federated models can reliably use synthesized missing modalities and weight client contributions by confidence, improving robustness under modality heterogeneity.
problem_solved: Addresses modality heterogeneity in multimodal federated learning where many sites lack some modalities; prior imputation methods produce point estimates without reliability, hurting aggregation and downstream decisions.
method: Probabilistic feature imputation: learn conditional distributions (not just point estimates) of missing-modality features from available modalities so imputed features carry uncertainty.
Uncertainty-aware federated aggregation: use imputation uncertainty to weight client updates and synthesized features during global aggregation, reducing influence of low-confidence imputations.

Privacy-preserving FL pipeline: perform local probabilistic imputation and uncertainty quantification on clients, then communicate only model summaries/confidence-weighted updates for centralized aggregation.
impact: Enables more reliable, calibrated multimodal federated models in settings with missing modalities (e.g., hospitals with partial data), improving safety and performance without sharing raw data.
visual_elements: Schematic of federated network: multiple hospitals/clients, each labeled with which modalities they have / miss; arrows show local probabilistic imputation and sending confidence-weighted updates to server.
Imputation illustration: comparison of point-estimate imputation vs a probability distribution (mean + variance) for a missing feature.
Aggregation diagram: server combining client updates with confidence weights (thicker arrows for high confidence) and a small formula/visual showing weighting by inverse uncertainty.
Performance/uncertainty chart: bar or line plot comparing accuracy and calibration (e.g., reliability diagram or error bars) of baseline point-imputation FL vs uncertainty-aware method.
paper_title: Probabilistic Feature Imputation and Uncertainty-Aware Multimodal Federated Aggregation
paper_authors: Nafis Fuad Shahid, Maroof Ahmed, Md Akib Haider, Saidur Rahman Sagor, Aashnan Rahman
